title: .NET Developer/Programmer :: Lansing, MI (Hybrid)
description:
.NET Developer/Programmer - Lansing, MI

Duration: 12+ months (Hybrid)

Position Summary:

The Remediation Information Data Exchange (RIDE) is an application facilitating data exchange related to contaminated properties under Part 201 and Part 213 of the Natural Resources and Environmental Protection Act. RIDE allows electronic document submissions, eliminating the need for regular mail. Future updates will support additional electronic submissions, including Baseline Environmental Assessments and other Part 201 documents. RIDE also hosts the Inventory of Facilities (IOF), providing a transparent account of work by RRD and public access to regulated facilities information.

Required Skills:

  • Advanced skills in SQL for writing database scripts, stored procedures, functions, triggers, and SSIS packages - 4 years
  • Advanced skills in C#.NET, VB.NET, ASP.NET, XML, AJAX, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Transact SQL (T-SQL) - 4 years
  • Knowledge of structured programming, object-oriented programming, relational database constructs, dynamic responsive web development - 4 years
  • Advanced skills in unit testing, system testing, regression testing, and automated testing - 4 years
  • Ability to provide quality customer service, build trust through integrity of work, and build strategic relationships through teamwork - 4 years
  • Skills in MS Visual Studio, MS Team Foundation Server/GIT, MS Office suite, MS SharePoint - 4 years
  • Skills in Angular - 1 year
  • Skills in TypeScript - 1 year
  • Knowledge of ADA Compliance - 1 year
  • Bachelor's degree in a related field

Preferred Skills:

  • MVC experience - 2 years
  • Knowledge of AI - 1 year
  • Knowledge of pipeline - 1 year

title: Senior IT Business Analyst :: Lansing, MI (Hybrid)
description:
Senior IT Business Analyst

Lansing, MI - Hybrid - 12+ Months

Seeking an experienced Senior IT Business Analyst with strong Quality Assurance and Azure DevOps expertise to lead business analysis efforts across complex technology initiatives. This role focuses on driving requirements discovery, improving business processes, supporting testing strategies, and ensuring high-quality software delivery within Agile environments.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Business Analysis Leadership:
    • Lead requirements gathering sessions, stakeholder interviews, and workshops.
    • Translate complex business requirements into functional specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
    • Create and maintain Business Requirement Documents (BRD) and Functional Requirement Documents (FRD).
    • Provide guidance and mentorship to junior business analysts.
  • Azure DevOps & Agile Delivery:
    • Manage and maintain product backlogs in Azure DevOps.
    • Collaborate with Product Owners and Scrum Masters to prioritize backlog items.
    • Ensure end-to-end requirements traceability using Azure DevOps work items.
  • Quality Assurance & Testing Oversight:
    • Define and review test strategies, test plans, and test cases.
    • Support and oversee functional, integration, regression, and User Acceptance Testing (UAT).
    • Manage defect lifecycle in Azure DevOps.
  • Process Improvement & Strategic Contribution:
    • Identify opportunities to improve business processes and system efficiencies.
    • Recommend technology solutions and automation opportunities.
  • Documentation & Stakeholder Communication:
    • Develop and maintain comprehensive documentation including workflows and system requirements.
    • Present analysis findings and project updates to leadership and stakeholders.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, or related field.
  • 7 years of experience as an IT Business Analyst on enterprise software projects.
  • Hands-on experience with Azure DevOps for backlog management, user stories, sprint tracking, and defect management (2 years).
  • Strong experience with software testing, QA processes, and UAT coordination.
  • Deep knowledge of Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban).
  • Excellent analytical, leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience working in enterprise-scale or multi-team Agile environments.
  • Familiarity with SQL, APIs, data integration, and system architecture concepts.
  • Experience supporting CI/CD pipelines and release management processes.

Key Skills:

  • Advanced Business Analysis
  • Stakeholder & Executive Communication
  • Azure DevOps (Boards, Backlogs, Work Items, Dashboards)
  • Agile / Scrum Methodology
  • QA Strategy & Test Planning
  • Defect Lifecycle Management
  • Process Modeling & Improvement
  • Requirements Traceability
  • Data & System Analysis

title: Director, AI Security Automation Engineering :: Bethesda, MD (Remote)
description:
Director, AI Security Automation Engineering

Location: Remote, Bethesda, MD

Contract Duration: 6 Months

Position Overview:

The Director will lead efforts to standardize and automate security reviews for AI systems. This role bridges security governance, engineering, and operations to create efficient, AI-assisted review processes. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in security risk assessment, AI/ML automation, and knowledge representation.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Security Review Process Standardization: Develop templates for AI deployment patterns and automate control checklists.
  • Throughput Engineering: Define complexity models and manage operational dashboards to track review metrics.
  • AI-Assisted Assessment Automation: Implement AI-powered assessment tools and automate intake and triage pipelines.
  • Pattern Graph and Knowledge Architecture: Build a queryable security pattern graph for comprehensive risk analysis.
  • Control Mapping and Evidence Pipelines: Develop pipelines to connect review findings with compliance reporting.
  • Governance Pipeline Optimization: Optimize the security review pipeline with AI-specific criteria and ensure EU AI Act compliance.
  • Cross-Functional Coordination: Collaborate with engineering and risk teams to enhance review processes.

Qualifications:

  • Education: Master's or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Systems, or related field.
  • Experience: 10 years in complex data models or system architectures and 2 years in cybersecurity or security risk management.
  • Proven experience in applying AI/ML for security and compliance automation at scale.
  • Strong track record of transforming manual processes into automated, metrics-driven operations.
  • Experience with knowledge graph architectures and graph-based reasoning in compliance and security domains.
  • Strong communication skills to engage with senior executives and cross-functional teams.

Technical Skills:

  • Deep understanding of AI system architectures and multi-agent orchestration patterns.
  • Experience with graph databases and knowledge representation tools like Neo4j and GraphML.
  • Proficiency in Go and Python for building automation tools and data pipelines.
  • Experience with AI/ML frameworks and security automation tools.
  • Familiarity with security review frameworks and controls such as NIST AI RMF and ISO 42001.
  • Experience with workflow platforms like ServiceNow or Jira for process automation.
  • Knowledge of secure DevOps/MLOps pipelines and security protocols.
